CustomField.description: Text formula that returns the branded donor grouping name (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion) based on GiftsThisYearAmount against the Annual_Min_Amount__c thresholds in FQS_Donor_Grouping custom metadata. Note: GiftsThisYearAmount is a calendar-year rollup from NPC; if your org uses a non-calendar fiscal year, validate whether this aligns with your reporting expectations. Returns blank when GiftsThisYearAmount is below the Entry annual threshold. Thresholds and branded names are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values or branded names recalculates this field retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. Shows the branded donor grouping name for this donor based on their current-year giving (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion). Blank means the donor is below the Entry annual threshold. Your administrator controls both the threshold amounts and donor grouping names.
CustomField.label: Annual Donor Grouping Name
